run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# 研究报告

OAuth 2.1 相对 OAuth 2.0 做了哪些调整，OIDC 在其上增加了什么？引用规范原文。

**结果：** `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`

## 已核验的部分事实

以下研究项已有原文证据支撑，但整体证据不足以形成完整结论，仅供参考。

### OpenID Connect (OIDC) · 规范基线版本

OAuth 2.1 is an in-progress effort to consolidate and simplify the most commonly used features of OAuth 2.0.

- Evidence: `evidence:aac9acba3a0b299ff9f02b9768418f24ec30c8278b4b1248`
  - Exact quote: “OAuth 2.1 is an in-progress effort to consolidate and simplify the most commonly used features of OAuth 2.0.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/a6f68d52-352f-440f-aadc-d9cd3ea9bf2f/bcc6332f6fea50d164de9e8be0fb7a14c78afec729b2a49be7c205969866c8b0`
  - URL: https://oauth.net/2.1/

### OpenID Connect (OIDC) · OIDC 与 OAuth 2.1 的关系

OAuth 2.0 Authentication Servers implementing OpenID Connect are also referred to as OpenID Providers (OPs).

- Evidence: `evidence:76fa6ab134ba34c2858231c14512985265b7030de3657ae9`
  - Exact quote: “OAuth 2.0 Authentication Servers implementing OpenID Connect are also referred to as OpenID Providers (OPs).”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/a895b383-76ee-4e6a-8df9-aa1882f6de1b/473a6c7fb5646ad5e93eea524d799e921aa086a3eb2c3f63d0091aac9cd30b46`
  - URL: https://www.itu.int/rec/dologin_pub.asp?lang=e&id=T-REC-X.1285-202505-I%21%21PDF-E&type=items

### OAuth 2.1 · 授权类型与流程变更

PKCE is required for all OAuth clients using the authorization code flow

- Evidence: `evidence:ed5e804d13d1d5dbff744f4fbe7df2e386b5f20666075137`
  - Exact quote: “PKCE is required for all OAuth clients using the authorization code flow”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/e7d60c1a-93fc-4a6f-896b-d0eb3a7f8fc0/bcc6332f6fea50d164de9e8be0fb7a14c78afec729b2a49be7c205969866c8b0`
  - URL: https://oauth.net/2.1/

### OAuth 2.1 · 规范基线版本

As of July 2026 it's still an IETF Internet-Draft (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-15), not an RFC.

- Evidence: `evidence:2af7e192e89f4001418e84b01b9feb86114d97cf1cdc1cd2`
  - Exact quote: “As of July 2026 it's still an IETF Internet-Draft (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-15), not an RFC.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/57c1720b-6940-4a1c-990c-158e35de4b79/fcc802377779c840391917ea30a6e02bb9b4493f8d15787fe172b91548fc5b19`
  - URL: https://blog.codercops.com/blog/oauth-2-1-explained-migration-guide-2026

columns.description: 回答 OAuth 2.1 相对 OAuth 2.0 在授权类型（grant type）和授权流程上的删除、保留和强制要求，包括 implicit 与 password grant 的移除。

columns.label: OIDC 新增协议层面

columns.label: 刷新令牌安全要求

brief.scope: OAuth 2.1 草案与 OAuth 2.0 RFC 6749/6750 及 OAuth 2.0 安全最佳实践的差异；OIDC Core 1.0 及 OIDC 相关规范在 OAuth 2.x 之上增加的协议能力。
brief.objective: 逐项引用规范原文，说明 OAuth 2.1 相对 OAuth 2.0 做了哪些调整，以及 OpenID Connect (OIDC) 在 OAuth 2.x 之上增加了什么。
exclusions: 不覆盖 OAuth 2.0 的所有扩展规范（如 DPoP、PAR）逐条分析，除非与 OAuth 2.1 合并内容直接相关
不覆盖 OIDC 的具体厂商实现差异与部署配置
不覆盖 OAuth 2.1 尚在草案阶段可能变化的非核心内容
